control.name: CONTROL — the wake reader strips the prefix and resolves the key string again, so a directory-form key is a non-canonical declaration and every slash-keyed receipt reads could-not-check

mutations.name: both-forms refusal removed (a receipt carrying scope:<decl> and scope:<decl>/ is accepted silently)
digest-format check removed (a non-digest value under a scope: key is read)
slash-form glob refusal removed (scope:<glob>/, never emitted, is normalised and read)
